milestone.title: mp autopilot session.json schema — durable per-session state for autopilot drives

intent.outcome: Every autopilot session has a single canonical, durable, versioned state file (session.json) that downstream milestones consume as source of truth for pane IDs, role config, queue state, and verifier verdicts.

problem.description: Today's mp watch keeps state in scattered files — `master-plan/.mp/watch.state.json` for the v2 control plane (M178), `master-plan/.mp/watch.log` for the structured log, and the milestone's own spec for execution. Recovering what happened to a session, especially after a crash or SIGINT (per M152), requires joining three files. The new mp autopilot design needs a single durable per-session record: pane IDs across orchestrator/runner/reviewer, role-config snapshots (so re-spawn reuses the same config), the milestone queue with per-milestone sub-state (cycle, stage, last notify), the topology in effect, and verifier verdicts. Reusing M178's control-plane shape gives a head start; this milestone adapts it to per-session folders and multi-milestone queues (with herdr workspace name `<project-name>-autopilot`).

in_scope: Define session.json schema: id, schema_version, herdr_workspace, topology, roles (per-role pane_id + model + harness + skill), config_overrides, queue (ordered milestone list with per-milestone stage/cycle/verifier_verdict/last_notify/evidence_refs), status, last_updated.
Validation: session.json validates against the project mini_schema (M188) with bounded read (32 MiB cap) and project-root containment.
Create-or-migrate scaffolding: when `mp autopilot start` runs against a plan with no autopilot/ dir, create the folder and write the schema-versioned session.json.
Document the schema in `docs/autopilot/session-format.md` so A2 (CLI rename), B (config+spawn), and C (verifier) can all reference it.
out_of_scope: The actual session lifecycle verbs (start/stop/pause/resume) — those land in B (config+spawn) and C (cycle governance).
Reading or surfacing session.json from raul — that's D1-D3.
Migration of legacy mp watch state into the new shape — covered by A2's legacy alias work.
Multi-session concurrency control — sessions are independent; this milestone is one session at a time.

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp autopilot session list` shows all sessions in the plan with id, status, last_updated; `mp autopilot session show <id>` renders the full session.json in canonical view.

acceptance_criteria.description: session.json extends with a `runner_notes: Vec<RunnerNote>` array (per the log's milestone-folder proposal: 'runner_notes.json — the runner's commentary on its own execution'). Each note has `kind ∈ {Workaround, Surprise, Blocker, Escalation, Question, Decision}`, `body: string`, `cycle: u8`, `at: timestamp`. Lanes write notes via `mp autopilot note <session-id> --kind Workaround --body "..."`. Tests pin a round-trip with one note per kind.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; when the matching test fixture exists, this verification is replaced with a per-AC `cargo nextest run -p <crate> --test <name> --no-fail-fast` command.

acceptance_criteria.description: session.json extends with `ac_pass_fail: Vec<AcPassFail>` per queued milestone (where `AcPassFail = { id: AC-XX, status: passed|failed|pending, evidence: string }`). This is the data source for the per-AC visualization (M216, latent surface #3) and the aggregate telemetry (M216, latent surface #4). Round-trip test fixture covers all three statuses per AC across multiple milestones in the queue.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; when the matching test fixture exists, this verification is replaced with a per-AC `cargo nextest run -p <crate> --test <name> --no-fail-fast` command.

design_decisions.choice: Per-session folder at `master-plan/autopilot/<id>/session.json` rather than a single global file.
design_decisions.rationale: Each session is a self-contained unit — easy to archive, diff, and recover. Concurrent writes serialize within one file; per-session folders unlock parallel-session writes (one per project checkout).

design_decisions.choice: Explicit `schema_version: integer` field; loaders reject unknown versions with a typed error. Bump on any breaking change.
design_decisions.rationale: The legacy mp watch state file (M152) already does this. Reusing the pattern means future migration paths compose cleanly.

design_decisions.choice: Queue is an ordered list; per-milestone sub-state is a typed object (not a sparse map).
design_decisions.rationale: Order matters for sequential execution (M179 ordered queue precedent); typed objects give the verifier a stable shape regardless of which milestone it's checking.
